text: Refunds are paid to the original card within 5 business days of the return arriving.
You can return an unused pump within 30 days with the receipt.
Every pump has a 2 year warranty covering seal and motor faults.
Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days; express ships next day.
Replace the shaft seal every 12 months or when you see a leak.
Reset your password from the sign-in page using the Forgot password link.
